rules.statement: The plaintiff's lien on the vessel for repairs is lost because he was deprived of possession by an order of the Court and did not claim a lien until many months later.
rules.supporting_quote: "But he was deprived of possession by an order of the Court, and did not then claim any lien; and he acquiesced the order, and made no claim to have a lien until many months afterwards, when he began this action."
